title: fix(fields): a markdown heading in a list cell draws at the cell's text size
body:
Fixes #36344

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户在列表里看到的变化:含 Markdown 字段的列表单元格,内容以标题开头时不再以大标题字号显示、也不再把这一行撑高,行高与其他行一致;记录详情页仍按原样显示大标题。
- 为什么做:列表视图体验修复,替在列表中显示富文本列的用户解决「标题被截断、行变高」的问题。
- 出错会怎样:最坏情况是列表里 Markdown 单元格的样式不对(只影响显示,不影响数据),可以直接撤回本次改动。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

- `@object-ui/fields` `MarkdownContent` gains a `face` prop: `document` (the default, unchanged) and `cell`. The cell face draws every heading level as a `p.font-semibold` (no heading element) and the body takes the surrounding cell's font size and line height (`text-[length:inherit] leading-[inherit]` on top of the same `prose prose-sm` typography).
- `MarkdownCellRenderer` picks the cell face when `inGridColumn` is set. `ObjectGrid` already passes `inGridColumn` on every column cell, and `RelatedList` on every table cell, so no host changes. The record page, readonly form fields and every other caller pass nothing and keep the `document` face with its heading sizes.
- `CellRendererProps.inGridColumn` JSDoc now names the `markdown` cell as its second reader.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/fields` patch.

Read first (by risk):
1. `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/MarkdownContent.tsx` — the cell face: `CELL_COMPONENTS` (heading levels mapped to a paragraph) and `MARKDOWN_CELL_FACE_CLASS`. Sanitisation is unchanged: the same `rehype-sanitize` schema runs in both faces; the component map only renames the element of a node the sanitiser already passed.
2. `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/richTextDisplay.tsx` — the one line that chooses the face from `inGridColumn`.
3. `ui/packages/fields/src/__tests__/markdownCellHeading-36344.test.tsx` — the pins and the record-page control.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/fields/src/__tests__/markdownCellHeading-36344.test.tsx packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.richTextOneLine-12480.test.tsx` from the repository root — expect 2 files, 8 tests passed.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/fields/src/__tests__/markdownCellHeading-36344.test.tsx` (3 cases): in a grid column, a `# Heading` value draws no `h1`-`h6`, the heading is a `p.font-semibold`, the body carries the two inherit classes and stays formatted; all six heading levels are drawn the same way; CONTROL — without `inGridColumn` (the record page path) the `h1` stays and the inherit classes are absent.
- New top-level `describe` in `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.richTextOneLine-12480.test.tsx` (the existing one-line-clamp harness): through the real `ObjectGrid`, the markdown cell inside the clamp is the cell face and `tbody` holds no heading element. This is the row-height contract the grid relies on (one line inside `line-clamp-1`, at the cell's line height).
- The existing readonly form pin (`readonly-richtext-display-5498.test.tsx`, a readonly markdown field keeps its `h1`) stays green: full-size displays keep their heading elements.

<details><summary>Ablation (one, the behaviour the pins hold)</summary>

The fix committed first; mutation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `richTextDisplay.tsx`, anchor `face={inGridColumn ? 'cell' : 'document'}` replaced by `face={'document'}` (anchor x1 to x0, blob c327713e to a365cf70). No build step: vitest resolves `@object-ui/fields` to `src` through `ui/vitest.config.mts`'s alias.

- Mutated: `Test Files 2 failed | 1 passed (3)`, `Tests 3 failed | 5 passed (8)`. The three cell-face cases went red (`AssertionError: expected` an empty `h1` element `to be null`), the record-page control and the original objectui#12480 cases stayed green.
- Restored: blob after restore c327713e == blob at HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Pixel reading (Chromium, not the live app)</summary>

Harness: the DOM of a real `ObjectGrid` render (jsdom, 4 rows: plain text, `# Heading` + paragraph, `**bold** and _em_`, `## Second level`) and of the record-page `MarkdownCellRenderer`, laid into a page with the Console's own stylesheet compiled from `ui/apps/console/src/index.css` (Tailwind 4 + typography), opened in Chromium at 1280 px. A temporary dump test, not committed.

| row | before (ablated) | after |
|---|---|---|
| plain text | 36 px | 36 px |
| `# Heading` + paragraph | 45 px (H1 30px / 36px line) | 36 px (P 14px / 17.5px line) |
| `**bold** and _em_` | 36 px | 36 px |
| `## Second level` | 36.5 px (H2 20px / 28px line) | 36 px |
| record page `h1` | 30 px | 30 px |

The 36 to 45 px reading matches the card's. NOT MEASURED in the running Console against a backend (the harness uses the real component DOM and the real stylesheet, but no live list page).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Scope edge: `wrap: true` columns also pass `inGridColumn`, so a wrapped markdown cell draws headings as bold lines at the cell size too. The block structure (paragraphs, lists) is kept, so a wrapped cell still shows the whole document, just without heading sizes. A list cell is not a full-size display, so this reads as within the card.
- Observation, not filed: the `html` / `richtext` cell (`HtmlCellRenderer`, a different pipeline, `renderSanitizedHtml`) keeps its heading elements in a grid cell under the same `prose prose-sm`, so a stored `h1` tag should draw the same way. Read from the code only; not measured at a public entry point, so it is noted here, not filed.
- Out of scope per the card: in-cell editing of rich-text fields (#36023, PR #36278). `overlap-check` before push: no open PR head shares a file with this branch, and the branch merges cleanly with `origin/main`.
